content: Self-attention mechanism enabling parallel processing of sequences. Revolutionized language models by replacing recurrent structures with position-aware attention.
Combines vector search with generative models to ground responses in external knowledge. Reduces hallucination by anchoring generation to retrieved documents.
Qubits can exist in multiple states simultaneously. Entangled particles remain correlated across arbitrary distances, enabling quantum teleportation.
Impossible to simultaneously guarantee Consistency, Availability, and Partition tolerance. Systems must choose 2 of 3 under network failures.
Store high-dimensional embeddings for similarity search. Pinecone, Weaviate, and Milvus enable fast nearest-neighbor queries for AI applications.
Consensus protocol tolerating malicious actors. Used in blockchains (PBFT, Tendermint) to maintain agreement despite arbitrary node behavior.
Any consistent formal system capable of arithmetic contains true statements that cannot be proven within the system. Limits of axiomatic reasoning.
Weighted focus on relevant input parts. Enables models to dynamically prioritize information, forming the core of transformers.
Store state changes as immutable events. Command Query Responsibility Segregation separates read and write models for scalability.
Binary instruction format running at near-native speed. Enables C/C++/Rust in browsers and server-side runtimes beyond JavaScript.
Apply deep learning to graph-structured data. Message passing between nodes learns representations of molecules, social networks, knowledge graphs.
Prove statement truth without revealing underlying data. zk-SNARKs enable private transactions and identity verification.
Learn to reverse noise-adding process. Stable Diffusion and DALL-E 2 iteratively denoise random latents into coherent images.
Monitoring checks known failure modes. Observability explores unknown unknowns through logs, metrics, traces without predefined dashboards.
Unified models processing images, text, audio. CLIP, Flamingo align vision-language spaces for cross-modal reasoning.
Train models across decentralized devices without centralizing data. Google's Gboard keyboard learns locally, aggregates gradients globally.
No algorithm can determine if arbitrary programs halt. Proved by Turing via self-referential contradiction.
Can every problem whose solution is quickly verifiable also be quickly solved? $1M prize unsolved for 50+ years.

summary: Entropy and the arrow of time
content: Second law: entropy always increases in closed systems. Explains why time flows forward and why scrambled eggs don't un-scramble.
Distributed commit log for real-time data pipelines. Topics, partitions, consumer groups enable high-throughput event streaming.
Run sandboxed programs in kernel space without changing source. Powers Cilium networking, bpftrace debugging, Falco security.
Shortest program that outputs a string. Incomputable but measures intrinsic randomness and data compressibility.
Learn from unlabeled data by predicting masked parts. BERT masks words, SimCLR augments images for contrastive learning.
Sidecar proxies handle service-to-service communication. Traffic management, security, observability without code changes.
Beauty in imperfection, impermanence, incompleteness. Celebrates cracks in pottery, rust on metal, the passage of time.
Empty malls, hotel hallways, airports at night. Transition zones that feel uncanny when devoid of human presence.
Underground fungal networks connect trees, transferring nutrients and chemical signals. The 'wood wide web' of forest communication.
Brainless organism solves shortest-path problems. Physarum recreated Tokyo rail network optimally using nutrient gradients.
Human replicas elicit revulsion when almost but not quite human. Affinity drops sharply before rising again at perfect realism.
Groups remember events that never occurred. Berenstain Bears misremembered as Berenstein. Mass false memory creation.
Earth functions as single self-regulating organism. Biosphere maintains conditions hospitable for life through feedback loops.
Seeing faces in clouds, toast, power outlets. Brain's pattern-matching overfires, finding meaning in randomness.
Visible signs of disorder encourage further disorder. One unrepaired broken window signals neglect, cascading into decay.
Circular prison where guards see all inmates from central tower. Awareness of potential surveillance self-disciplines subjects.
Space-efficient set membership test. False positives possible, false negatives never. Used in databases, caches, spell checkers.
Understandable alternative to Paxos. Leader election, log replication, safety via term numbers and committed entries.
Humans maintain stable relationships with ~150 people. Neocortex size constrains social group capacity across primates.
Convergent Replicated Data Types merge concurrent edits without coordination. Powers Figma multiplayer, Redis, automerge.
Fine-tune models using human preference comparisons. PPO optimizes policy toward reward model trained on ranked outputs.
Usenet overwhelmed by AOL users in 1993. Influx of newcomers permanently shifted online culture from expert to mainstream.
